Based on the image provided:

(A) **The native OS arrow cursor is not visible** in this crop. The image only shows a small white solid dot and a larger white ring on a black background. There is no standard arrow-shaped cursor present.

(B) **The circle/ring is large**, occupying a significant portion of the right side of the image (roughly 1/4 to 1/5 of the image's width). Since there is no arrow cursor, it cannot be determined if it is inside, on the edge, or outside. Consequently, **the circle is not centered on an arrow cursor** because no such cursor exists in the frame.
